actions.name: Setup
actions.description: Links node_modules from the main checkout when the lockfiles match (otherwise npm ci) and links env files that are missing.

actions.name: Run dev slot
actions.description: This checkout's own dev copy of the Hub (npm run hub:dev): its own slot, port and data folder.

actions.name: Check
actions.description: The web, script and Rust checks (npm run check).

actions.name: Ship
actions.description: Installs this checkout's checked build as the daily app, with a trial and automatic rollback (npm run hub:ship).
actions.confirm: Ship replaces the daily MonoCode Hub with this checkout's build and restarts it when it is idle. Continue?
